style_template: A cute {subject}. 3/4 top-down view as in cozy farming games, character seen slightly from above, facing slightly left. Flat cel shading with at most two shadow tones, no gradients, no photorealism, no painterly texture. Thick rounded dark warm-brown outline (#3A2E28) with uniform weight. Warm cozy palette built on cream, wood brown and leaf green. Soft key light from the top left. Big simple readable silhouette, no fine details. Single subject centered, filling about 80% of the canvas height, feet resting on a level ground line at about 88% of canvas height. No text, no watermark, no background elements, no cast shadow on the ground. Transparent background.

tiles.note: Second job type, run with --tiles. Ground textures, not sprites: a different model, a different style block, and no candidate suffix - zoo_map.gd loads these by exact filename.
tiles.style_template: A seamless repeating ground texture of {subject}, seen from directly above, flat top-down view. Cozy cartoon game art style, flat cel shading with at most two tones, no outline, no border, no vignette, no directional shadow, even flat lighting across the whole image. Warm cozy palette of cream, wood brown and leaf green. Subtle even detail with no large features and no strong direction, so the texture reads as a uniform fill. No subjects, no props, no animals, no text, no watermark. Fills the entire square edge to edge.

subjects.subject: short green grass with a few tiny pale wildflowers scattered evenly
packed light dirt with fine gravel, an even scatter of small stones with no ruts, no tracks, no lanes and no direction of travel
calm shallow blue water with a fine even dimpled surface, ripples equally scattered in all directions with no waves, no current and no direction of flow
clean pale snow with a faint even powder texture
dense rounded green hedge foliage, small tight leaf clusters, slightly darker than the grass
subjects.note: DEFERRED on purpose. This is the zone BORDER tile and zoo_map.gd paints the same one for all four edges AND all four corners, so it must be perfectly isotropic. Judge it in context once the ground tiles are in; a directional fence would need a 6-8 piece set plus changes to _build_tileset and _paint_zoo_layout.
